title: scrumia-specs — ScrumIA
meta_description: scrumia-specs: the ScrumIA specs slot — per-feature specs as a contextual file catalogue.
tagline: Per-feature specs, as a catalogue of targeted files rather than one document.
responsibilities: Owns where a specification lives and what shape it takes: one directory per feature, each file with a defined reader — the business rules, the acceptance criteria, the technical choices, the interface. Creates a feature, updates it, audits it, and finds the one that owns a rule without reading the whole tree.
refusals: No fixed template, and no history inside a spec: a file exists only when it has content, and what changed belongs to git and the tickets.
philosophy: Assumes specs live in the repo, next to the code they describe. Costs more judgement when writing than a template would — the catalogue tells you which file may exist, never which one you owe.
